## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Domain heart**: This is the pipeline/opportunity management core. Together with sales/sale_order, forms the "Lead-to-Cash" flow component. Should be grouped with sales and account.
- **Activity-centric**: Heavily integrates with mail.activity for task/reminder management — coordinates with task deadlines and assignments.
- **Team coordination**: crm_team_member model extends sales teams with CRM-specific role mappings — couples with sales_team.
- **Lead lifecycle**: crm_lead moves through stages (pipeline) and can convert to res.partner (customer) or merge with other leads — key boundary between CRM and sales.
- **Predictive scoring**: Built-in lead scoring (PLS) engine reads configuration and updates lead probability — analytics foundation.
- **Boundary code**: controllers/main.py handles email-to-lead conversion and inbound webhook routing — integrates external email systems.
- **Phone validation**: Imported phone field enhancement — ensures data quality for outbound dialing/SMS.
